# `company.purchase_order_line_identities`

Stable ordered-line identities; identities omitted by a later revision never return.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1, unique with document_id + id | — | — | Stable document-local line identity. |
| `document_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with document_id + id | — | purchase_orders.id | Purchase order that permanently owns this line identity. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this purchase order history was written. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that wrote this history. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that wrote this history. |
